description: This PHP source file defines the internal Smarty plugin class 'Smarty_Internal_Resource_Stream' which implements stream-based resource handling for Smarty templates. It includes methods for populating template source metadata, loading content from streams, and building unique resource names.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Resource_Stream
classes.description: A class implementing resource streams as a template resource in Smarty, extending Smarty_Resource_Recompiled, handling content loading, metadata population, and resource name building.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates the template source object with metadata, including the file path, UID, content, and timestamp based on the resource string.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Reads the template source content from a file stream and returns it as a string, or false if unable to read.

methods.name: buildUniqueResourceName
methods.description: Constructs a unique resource name based on the class and resource identifier.
